text: Preventing SIDS via data analysis: [LINK] Original Microsoft Surface (tabletop computing): [VIDEO] Real-time language translation on Skype: [LINK] TouchWall: [LINK] F#, TypeScript, P, and possibly other programming languages HoloDesk Kinect Industry-leading speech recognition: [LINK] HomeOS There are more, but I'm too lazy to Google it. They also had a dual-screen, folding tablet that I really wished had made it to the market, but I can't remember the name.

Microsoft Surface Demo @ CES 2008: [VIDEO] Every time I see a Surface demo I'm struck at the whole "display photos as a jumbled mess, just like real photos!" thing. It just seems so... idiotic. Anyway, there does seem to be some potential with Surface but it does seem like a bit of a waste in the hands of Microsoft.
